description: The handful of questions only this person can answer about their own seat -- whether they are clear on what they own, whether they could describe where the organization is going, whether the recurring work is done the same way everyone else does it. OTP cannot observe any of that, so it asks. Returns only unanswered questions for the current period, and only for seats the caller holds. Ask these conversationally, one at a time, and never all at once.
name: my_coaching_questions
